/*
    Dashboard Thống kê tuyển sinh — DASH_StudentAdmission_GetFilter
    Lấy danh sách Khóa / Chuyên ngành từ hồ sơ tuyển sinh

    @ListType  — 1 = Khóa (SIM_Course qua đợt TS)
               — 2 = Chuyên ngành (SIM_SpecialBranch)
    @CourseID  — tuỳ chọn, lọc chuyên ngành theo khóa (ListType = 2)
*/

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DASH_StudentAdmission_GetFilter', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.DASH_StudentAdmission_GetFilter;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.DASH_StudentAdmission_GetFilter
(
    @CourseID nvarchar(1000) = NULL,
    @ListType tinyint
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @ListType = 1
    BEGIN
        Select Distinct
            SIM_Course.CourseID,
            SIM_Course.CourseName
        From SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod
            Inner Join SIM_Course On SIM_Course.CourseID = SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod.CourseID
        Where SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod.CourseID is not null
            And Exists
            (
                Select 1
                From SIM_StudentCollection
                Where SIM_StudentCollection.StudentCollectionPeriodID = SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod.StudentCollectionPeriodID
                    And SIM_StudentCollection.IsDeleted = 0
            )
        Order by SIM_Course.CourseName;
        RETURN;
    END

    IF @ListType = 2
    BEGIN
        Select Distinct
            SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID,
            SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchShortName,
            SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchName
        From SIM_StudentCollection
            Inner Join SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod
                On SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod.StudentCollectionPeriodID = SIM_StudentCollection.StudentCollectionPeriodID
            Inner Join SIM_SpecialBranch
                On SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID = SIM_StudentCollection.SpecialBranchID
        Where SIM_StudentCollection.IsDeleted = 0
            And
            (
                @CourseID is null
                Or @CourseID = N''
                Or Charindex(',' + SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod.CourseID + ',', ',' + @CourseID + ',') > 0
            )
        Order by SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchName;
        RETURN;
    END
END
GO

/*
    Dashboard Thống kê tuyển sinh — DASH_StudentAdmission_GetData
    Nguồn logic: SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB
    Bảng: SIM_StudentCollection, SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod, SIM_SpecialBranch,
          SIM_StudentCollectionQuota, SIM_Student, ACC_Receipt, SIM_Course

    @YearID            — năm lấy chỉ tiêu (Quota)
    @CourseID          — danh sách khóa, cách nhau dấu phẩy
    @SpecialBranchID   — danh sách chuyên ngành, cách nhau dấu phẩy
    @FromDate/@ToDate  — lọc theo ReceiveDate; mặc định tháng hiện tại
    @ResultSet:
        1 — KPI tổng quan
        2 — Theo chuyên ngành (bảng)
        3 — Theo khóa (biểu đồ)
        4 — Theo tháng nhận hồ sơ
        NULL — trả đủ 4 result set
*/

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DASH_StudentAdmission_GetData', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.DASH_StudentAdmission_GetData;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.DASH_StudentAdmission_GetData
(
    @YearID int = NULL,
    @CourseID nvarchar(1000) = NULL,
    @SpecialBranchID nvarchar(1000) = NULL,
    @FromDate datetime = NULL,
    @ToDate datetime = NULL,
    @ResultSet tinyint = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @CourseID = N''
        SET @CourseID = NULL;

    IF @SpecialBranchID = N''
        SET @SpecialBranchID = NULL;

    IF @FromDate IS NULL
        SET @FromDate = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0);

    IF @ToDate IS NULL
        SET @ToDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0)));

    -- Bao gồm cả ngày cuối (23:59:59)
    SET @ToDate = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(CONVERT(varchar(10), @ToDate, 120) as datetime)));

    -- Hồ sơ đã đóng học phí (có biên lai)
    Select
        tbl2.StudentCollectionID,
        Convert(bit, 1) as HP
    Into #tblHP
    From SIM_StudentCollection tbl2
        Inner Join SIM_Student On SIM_Student.StudentCollectionID = tbl2.StudentCollectionID
        Inner Join ACC_Receipt On ACC_Receipt.StudentID = SIM_Student.StudentID
            And ACC_Receipt.IsDeleted = 0
    Group by tbl2.StudentCollectionID;

    -- Dữ liệu hồ sơ theo bộ lọc
    Select
        tbl.StudentCollectionID,
        tbl.SpecialBranchID,
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchShortName,
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchName,
        tblPeriod.CourseID,
        IsNull(SIM_Course.CourseName, tblPeriod.CourseID) as CourseName,
        tbl.ReceiveDate,
        tbl.Gender,
        tbl.IsReturnMoney,
        tbl.IsStudyLogic,
        Case When #tblHP.HP is not null then 1 else 0 end as HasPaid,
        IsNull(SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.Quota, 0) as Quota
    Into #tblAdmission
    From SIM_StudentCollection tbl
        Inner Join SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod tblPeriod
            On tblPeriod.StudentCollectionPeriodID = tbl.StudentCollectionPeriodID
        Inner Join SIM_SpecialBranch
            On SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID = tbl.SpecialBranchID
        Left Join SIM_Course
            On SIM_Course.CourseID = tblPeriod.CourseID
        Left Join SIM_StudentCollectionQuota
            On SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.SpecialBranchID = tbl.SpecialBranchID
            And SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.YearID = @YearID
        Left Join #tblHP
            On #tblHP.StudentCollectionID = tbl.StudentCollectionID
    Where tbl.IsDeleted = 0
        And
        (
            @CourseID is null
            Or Charindex(',' + tblPeriod.CourseID + ',', ',' + @CourseID + ',') > 0
        )
        And
        (
            @SpecialBranchID is null
            Or Charindex(',' + tbl.SpecialBranchID + ',', ',' + @SpecialBranchID + ',') > 0
        )
        And (@FromDate is null Or tbl.ReceiveDate >= @FromDate)
        And (@ToDate is null Or tbl.ReceiveDate <= @ToDate);

    /* Result set 1 — KPI */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 1
    BEGIN
        Select
            Count(*) as TotalEnrolled,
            IsNull(Sum(DistinctQuota.Quota), 0) as TotalQuota,
            Sum(Case When IsReturnMoney = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as ReturnMoneyCount,
            Sum(Case When HasPaid = 1 And IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as PaidCount,
            Sum(Case When Gender = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as MaleCount,
            Sum(Case When Gender = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as FemaleCount,
            Cast(
                Case
                    When IsNull(Sum(DistinctQuota.Quota), 0) = 0 then 0
                    Else (Count(*) * 100.0) / Sum(DistinctQuota.Quota)
                End
            as decimal(10, 2)) as PercentQuota
        From #tblAdmission
            Outer Apply
            (
                Select Top 1 q.Quota
                From #tblAdmission q
                Where q.SpecialBranchID = #tblAdmission.SpecialBranchID
            ) as DistinctQuota;
    END

    /* Result set 1 (sửa KPI Quota không bị nhân theo số hồ sơ) — dùng CTE riêng */
    -- Ghi đè cách tính Quota đúng hơn nếu ResultSet = 1 đã chạy ở trên bị nhân
    -- Thay bằng cách tính chuẩn bên dưới khi gọi lại. DROP và tính lại:

    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 1
    BEGIN
        -- Xóa kết quả KPI vừa Select nếu client chỉ lấy lần gọi riêng từng ResultSet thì OK.
        -- Khi API gọi từng ResultSet một lần thì chỉ có 1 Select.
        -- Khi @ResultSet NULL sẽ bị 2 lần ResultSet 1 — cần tránh.
        -- => Sửa: chỉ giữ 1 khối KPI bên dưới. Khối trên sẽ bị bỏ.
        Select 1;
    END
END
GO

content.text: Đang viết lại SP GetData cho sạch — bản trước bị lỗi logic KPI.

/*
    Dashboard Thống kê tuyển sinh — DASH_StudentAdmission_GetData
    Nguồn logic: SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB
    Bảng: SIM_StudentCollection, SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod, SIM_SpecialBranch,
          SIM_StudentCollectionQuota, SIM_Student, ACC_Receipt, SIM_Course

    @YearID            — năm lấy chỉ tiêu (Quota)
    @CourseID          — danh sách khóa, cách nhau dấu phẩy
    @SpecialBranchID   — danh sách chuyên ngành, cách nhau dấu phẩy
    @FromDate/@ToDate  — lọc theo ReceiveDate; mặc định tháng hiện tại
    @ResultSet:
        1 — KPI tổng quan
        2 — Theo chuyên ngành (bảng)
        3 — Theo khóa (biểu đồ)
        4 — Theo tháng nhận hồ sơ
        NULL — trả đủ 4 result set
*/

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.DASH_StudentAdmission_GetData', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.DASH_StudentAdmission_GetData;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.DASH_StudentAdmission_GetData
(
    @YearID int = NULL,
    @CourseID nvarchar(1000) = NULL,
    @SpecialBranchID nvarchar(1000) = NULL,
    @FromDate datetime = NULL,
    @ToDate datetime = NULL,
    @ResultSet tinyint = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    IF @CourseID = N''
        SET @CourseID = NULL;

    IF @SpecialBranchID = N''
        SET @SpecialBranchID = NULL;

    IF @FromDate IS NULL
        SET @FromDate = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0);

    IF @ToDate IS NULL
        SET @ToDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, DATEADD(MONTH, 1, DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), 0)));

    -- Bao gồm cả ngày cuối (23:59:59)
    SET @ToDate = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(CONVERT(varchar(10), @ToDate, 120) as datetime)));

    -- Hồ sơ đã đóng học phí (có biên lai)
    Select
        tbl2.StudentCollectionID,
        Convert(bit, 1) as HP
    Into #tblHP
    From SIM_StudentCollection tbl2
        Inner Join SIM_Student On SIM_Student.StudentCollectionID = tbl2.StudentCollectionID
        Inner Join ACC_Receipt On ACC_Receipt.StudentID = SIM_Student.StudentID
            And ACC_Receipt.IsDeleted = 0
    Group by tbl2.StudentCollectionID;

    -- Dữ liệu hồ sơ theo bộ lọc
    Select
        tbl.StudentCollectionID,
        tbl.SpecialBranchID,
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchShortName,
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchName,
        tblPeriod.CourseID,
        IsNull(SIM_Course.CourseName, tblPeriod.CourseID) as CourseName,
        tbl.ReceiveDate,
        tbl.Gender,
        tbl.IsReturnMoney,
        Case When #tblHP.HP is not null then 1 else 0 end as HasPaid,
        IsNull(SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.Quota, 0) as Quota
    Into #tblAdmission
    From SIM_StudentCollection tbl
        Inner Join SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod tblPeriod
            On tblPeriod.StudentCollectionPeriodID = tbl.StudentCollectionPeriodID
        Inner Join SIM_SpecialBranch
            On SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID = tbl.SpecialBranchID
        Left Join SIM_Course
            On SIM_Course.CourseID = tblPeriod.CourseID
        Left Join SIM_StudentCollectionQuota
            On SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.SpecialBranchID = tbl.SpecialBranchID
            And SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.YearID = @YearID
        Left Join #tblHP
            On #tblHP.StudentCollectionID = tbl.StudentCollectionID
    Where tbl.IsDeleted = 0
        And
        (
            @CourseID is null
            Or Charindex(',' + tblPeriod.CourseID + ',', ',' + @CourseID + ',') > 0
        )
        And
        (
            @SpecialBranchID is null
            Or Charindex(',' + tbl.SpecialBranchID + ',', ',' + @SpecialBranchID + ',') > 0
        )
        And (@FromDate is null Or tbl.ReceiveDate >= @FromDate)
        And (@ToDate is null Or tbl.ReceiveDate <= @ToDate);

    -- Chỉ tiêu theo chuyên ngành (không nhân theo số hồ sơ)
    Select
        SpecialBranchID,
        Max(Quota) as Quota
    Into #tblQuota
    From #tblAdmission
    Group by SpecialBranchID;

    Declare @TotalQuota int;
    Select @TotalQuota = IsNull(Sum(Quota), 0) From #tblQuota;

    /* Result set 1 — KPI */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 1
    BEGIN
        Select
            Count(*) as TotalEnrolled,
            @TotalQuota as TotalQuota,
            Sum(Case When IsReturnMoney = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as ReturnMoneyCount,
            Sum(Case When HasPaid = 1 And IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as PaidCount,
            Sum(Case When Gender = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as MaleCount,
            Sum(Case When Gender = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as FemaleCount,
            Cast(
                Case
                    When @TotalQuota = 0 then 0
                    Else (Count(*) * 100.0) / @TotalQuota
                End
            as decimal(10, 2)) as PercentQuota
        From #tblAdmission;
    END

    /* Result set 2 — Theo chuyên ngành */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 2
    BEGIN
        Select
            a.SpecialBranchID,
            Max(a.SpecialBranchShortName) as SpecialBranchShortName,
            Max(a.SpecialBranchName) as SpecialBranchName,
            Max(a.Quota) as Quota,
            Count(*) as EnrolledCount,
            Sum(Case When a.IsReturnMoney = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as ReturnMoneyCount,
            Sum(Case When a.HasPaid = 1 And a.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as PaidCount,
            Sum(Case When a.Gender = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as MaleCount,
            Sum(Case When a.Gender = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as FemaleCount,
            Cast(
                Case
                    When Max(a.Quota) = 0 then 0
                    Else (Count(*) * 100.0) / Max(a.Quota)
                End
            as decimal(10, 2)) as PercentQuota
        From #tblAdmission a
        Group by a.SpecialBranchID
        Order by EnrolledCount desc, Max(a.SpecialBranchName);
    END

    /* Result set 3 — Theo khóa */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 3
    BEGIN
        Select
            a.CourseID,
            Max(a.CourseName) as CourseName,
            Count(*) as EnrolledCount,
            Sum(Case When a.IsReturnMoney = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as ReturnMoneyCount,
            Sum(Case When a.HasPaid = 1 And a.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as PaidCount,
            Sum(Case When a.Gender = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as MaleCount,
            Sum(Case When a.Gender = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as FemaleCount
        From #tblAdmission a
        Where a.CourseID is not null
        Group by a.CourseID
        Order by EnrolledCount desc, Max(a.CourseName);
    END

    /* Result set 4 — Theo tháng nhận hồ sơ */
    IF @ResultSet IS NULL OR @ResultSet = 4
    BEGIN
        Select
            Month(a.ReceiveDate) as MonthNo,
            N'T' + Cast(Month(a.ReceiveDate) as nvarchar(2)) as MonthLabel,
            Count(*) as EnrolledCount,
            Sum(Case When a.IsReturnMoney = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as ReturnMoneyCount
        From #tblAdmission a
        Where a.ReceiveDate is not null
        Group by Month(a.ReceiveDate)
        Order by MonthNo;
    END

    Drop Table #tblAdmission;
    Drop Table #tblQuota;
    Drop Table #tblHP;
END
GO

/*
    Ví dụ test:
    Exec dbo.DASH_StudentAdmission_GetData @YearID = 2025, @ResultSet = 1;
    Exec dbo.DASH_StudentAdmission_GetData @YearID = 2025, @CourseID = N'K21', @FromDate = '2025-01-01', @ToDate = '2025-12-31', @ResultSet = 2;
*/

USE [thienhaso_SIMS_CD_Nghe21_2025]
GO

/*
    SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB
    Thống kê chỉ tiêu / đã tuyển theo chuyên ngành (WinForms + Web)

    Đã rà / chỉnh:
    - DROP + CREATE ổn định khi deploy lại
    - @ToDate bao gồm cả ngày cuối (23:59:59)
    - @CourseID / @SpecialBranchIDList hỗ trợ nhiều giá trị (',' hoặc ';')
    - Bỏ ORDER BY trong SELECT INTO
    - Thêm SpecialBranchShortName (mã nghề)
    - Final SELECT có ORDER BY
*/

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB]
(
    @YearID int = null, -- năm để lấy chỉ tiêu
    @CourseID NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL,
    @TrainingType NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
    @TrainingLevelID NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
    @StudentCollectionPeriodIDList varchar(4000) = null,
    @BranchID nvarchar(50) = null,
    @SpecialBranchID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @SpecialBranchIDList nvarchar(max) = null,

    @FromDate DATETIME = NULL,
    @ToDate DATETIME = NULL,
    @Result TINYINT = NULL    	    -- 0. Ko dat, 1.NV1, 2. Nv2, 3. Nv3, 4. Đạt
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- tìm hồ sơ theo ds đợt tuyển sinh trước
    If ISNULL(@StudentCollectionPeriodIDList, '') = '' set @StudentCollectionPeriodIDList = null
    If @SpecialBranchIDList = '' set @SpecialBranchIDList = null
    If @CourseID = '' set @CourseID = null

    -- Chuẩn hoá list: hỗ trợ cả ';' và ','
    If @SpecialBranchIDList is not null
        set @SpecialBranchIDList = Replace(@SpecialBranchIDList, ',', ';')

    If @CourseID is not null And Charindex(',', @CourseID) > 0
        set @CourseID = Replace(@CourseID, ',', ';')

    If @SpecialBranchID is not null
    Begin
        set @BranchID = null
        set @SpecialBranchIDList = null
    End

    -- Bao gồm cả ngày cuối nếu truyền @ToDate không có giờ
    If @ToDate is not null And Convert(varchar(8), @ToDate, 108) = '00:00:00'
        set @ToDate = Dateadd(second, -1, Dateadd(day, 1, @ToDate))

    Select *
    Into #tblPeriod
    From SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod as tblPeriod
        Left join dbo.fnSplit(@StudentCollectionPeriodIDList, ';') as tblPart on tblPart.part = tblPeriod.StudentCollectionPeriodID
    Where (@StudentCollectionPeriodIDList is null or tblPart.part is not null)

    Select
        tbl2.StudentCollectionID,
        convert(bit, 1) as HP
    Into #tblHP
    From SIM_StudentCollection tbl2
        Inner join SIM_Student on SIM_Student.StudentCollectionID = tbl2.StudentCollectionID
        Inner join ACC_Receipt on ACC_Receipt.StudentID = SIM_Student.StudentID
            and ACC_Receipt.IsDeleted = 0
    Group by tbl2.StudentCollectionID

    Select
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID,
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchShortName,
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchName,

        COUNT(*) as "TotalCount", -- trúng tuyển
        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as "VH",

        SUM(case when tbl.IsReturnMoney = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as "ReturnMoneyCount", -- số hồ sơ rút tiền CHƯA đóng tiền
        SUM(case when tbl.IsReturnMoney = 1 and HP is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "ReturnMoneyCount_T", -- số hồ sơ rút tiền ĐÃ đóng tiền
        SUM(CASE WHEN tbl.Gender = '0' THEN 1 ELSE null END) AS "FemaleCount",
        SUM(CASE WHEN tbl.Gender = '1' THEN 1 ELSE null END) AS "MaleCount",
        SUM(case when TrainingLevelID IN ('NH', 'SC', 'TC') then 1 else 0 end) as "Total3_CER", -- tổng 3 loại nhận
        SUM(case when HP is not null and TrainingLevelID IN ('NH', 'SC', 'TC') then 1 else 0 end) as "Total3_HP",
        SUM(case when HP is null and TrainingLevelID IN ('NH', 'SC', 'TC') and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else null end) as "N_HP", -- chưa đóng tiền

        Sum(Case when SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223') and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else null end) as "KHTN",
        Sum(Case when SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID not in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223') and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else null end) as "KHXH",

        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1 and SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223') and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else null end) as "VH_KHTN",
        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1 and SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID not in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223') and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else null end) as "VH_KHXH",
        SUM(case when TrainingLevelID IN ('NH', 'SC', 'TC') and tbl.Description like 'TB%' then 1 else 0 end) as "CS_TB",
        SUM(case when TrainingLevelID IN ('NH', 'SC', 'TC') and tbl.Description like 'Q12%' and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as "CS_Q12",
        SUM(case when HP is not null and TrainingLevelID IN ('NH', 'SC', 'TC') and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as "CS1",

        -- Học VĂN HÓA BAN TỰ NHIÊN - Khối thi XH và TN
        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1
                    and SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223')
                    and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0
                    and tbl.StudentCollectionGroupID = 1
            then 1 else null end) as "VH_KHTN_KhoiThi_XH",

        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1
                    and SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223')
                    and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0
                    and tbl.StudentCollectionGroupID = 2
            then 1 else null end) as "VH_KHTN_KhoiThi_TN",

        -- Học VĂN HÓA BAN - XÃ HỘI - Khối thi XH và TN
        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1
                    and SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID not in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223')
                    and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0
                    and tbl.StudentCollectionGroupID = 1
            then 1 else null end) as "VH_KHXH_KhoiThi_XH",

        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1
                    and SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID not in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223')
                    and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0
                    and tbl.StudentCollectionGroupID = 2
            then 1 else null end) as "VH_KHXH_KhoiThi_TN",

        SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.Quota --- chỉ tiêu

    Into #tblData
    from SIM_StudentCollection tbl
        Inner join #tblPeriod tblPeriod on tblPeriod.StudentCollectionPeriodID = tbl.StudentCollectionPeriodID
        Inner join SIM_SpecialBranch on SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID = tbl.SpecialBranchID

        LEFT JOIN SIM_StudentCollectionQuota ON SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.SpecialBranchID = tbl.SpecialBranchID
            and SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.YearID = @YearID

        Left join #tblHP on #tblHP.StudentCollectionID = tbl.StudentCollectionID

        Left join dbo.fnSplit(@SpecialBranchIDList, ';') as tblPart on tblPart.part = tbl.SpecialBranchID
        Left join dbo.fnSplit(@CourseID, ';') as tblCoursePart on tblCoursePart.part = tblPeriod.CourseID

    WHERE tbl.IsDeleted = 0
        and (@CourseID is null or tblCoursePart.part is not null or (Charindex(';', @CourseID) = 0 and tblPeriod.CourseID = @CourseID))
        and (@TrainingLevelID is null or tblPeriod.TrainingLevelID = @TrainingLevelID)
        and (@TrainingType is null or tblPeriod.TrainingType = @TrainingType)
        AND (@BranchID IS NULL OR SIM_SpecialBranch.BranchID = @BranchID)
        And (@SpecialBranchID is null or SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID = @SpecialBranchID)
        and (@SpecialBranchIDList is null or tblPart.part is not null)
        AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR tbl.ReceiveDate >= @FromDate)
        AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR tbl.ReceiveDate <= @ToDate)

    Group by SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID,
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchShortName,
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchName,
        SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.Quota

    ------- select ----
    Select *,
        (Select SUM(FemaleCount) from #tblData) as FemaleCount_2,
        (Select SUM(MaleCount) from #tblData) as "MaleCount_2",
        CAST((TotalCount * 100.0) / NULLIF(Quota, 0) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) as "Percent",
        Total3_CER - ReturnMoneyCount as "T1",
        Total3_HP - ReturnMoneyCount_T as T2,
        CS1 as T4,
        CS_TB as T5,
        CS_Q12 as T6,
        VH_KHTN_KhoiThi_XH as T7,
        VH_KHTN_KhoiThi_TN as T8,
        VH_KHXH_KhoiThi_XH as T9,
        VH_KHXH_KhoiThi_TN as T10,
        'a' as T11
    from #tblData
    Order by SpecialBranchID

    Drop table #tblPeriod
    Drop table #tblData
    Drop table #tblHP
END
GO

/*
    SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB — bản chỉnh cho deploy
    (file gốc sql/tuyển sinh/SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu.sql đang UTF-16)

    Đã rà / chỉnh so với bản gốc:
    - DROP + CREATE ổn định khi deploy lại
    - @ToDate bao gồm cả ngày cuối (23:59:59)
    - @CourseID / @SpecialBranchIDList hỗ trợ nhiều giá trị (',' hoặc ';')
    - Bỏ ORDER BY trong SELECT INTO
    - Thêm SpecialBranchShortName (mã nghề)
    - Final SELECT có ORDER BY
    - SET NOCOUNT ON

    Dashboard web dùng: DASH_StudentAdmission_GetData (cùng nguồn logic, ResultSet).
*/

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB', N'P') IS NOT NULL
    DROP PROCEDURE dbo.SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB]
(
    @YearID int = null,
    @CourseID NVARCHAR(4000) = NULL,
    @TrainingType NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
    @TrainingLevelID NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
    @StudentCollectionPeriodIDList varchar(4000) = null,
    @BranchID nvarchar(50) = null,
    @SpecialBranchID nvarchar(50) = NULL,
    @SpecialBranchIDList nvarchar(max) = null,
    @FromDate DATETIME = NULL,
    @ToDate DATETIME = NULL,
    @Result TINYINT = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    If ISNULL(@StudentCollectionPeriodIDList, '') = '' set @StudentCollectionPeriodIDList = null
    If @SpecialBranchIDList = '' set @SpecialBranchIDList = null
    If @CourseID = '' set @CourseID = null

    If @SpecialBranchIDList is not null
        set @SpecialBranchIDList = Replace(@SpecialBranchIDList, ',', ';')

    If @CourseID is not null And Charindex(',', @CourseID) > 0
        set @CourseID = Replace(@CourseID, ',', ';')

    If @SpecialBranchID is not null
    Begin
        set @BranchID = null
        set @SpecialBranchIDList = null
    End

    If @ToDate is not null And Convert(varchar(8), @ToDate, 108) = '00:00:00'
        set @ToDate = Dateadd(second, -1, Dateadd(day, 1, @ToDate))

    Select *
    Into #tblPeriod
    From SIM_StudentCollectionPeriod as tblPeriod
        Left join dbo.fnSplit(@StudentCollectionPeriodIDList, ';') as tblPart on tblPart.part = tblPeriod.StudentCollectionPeriodID
    Where (@StudentCollectionPeriodIDList is null or tblPart.part is not null)

    Select
        tbl2.StudentCollectionID,
        convert(bit, 1) as HP
    Into #tblHP
    From SIM_StudentCollection tbl2
        Inner join SIM_Student on SIM_Student.StudentCollectionID = tbl2.StudentCollectionID
        Inner join ACC_Receipt on ACC_Receipt.StudentID = SIM_Student.StudentID
            and ACC_Receipt.IsDeleted = 0
    Group by tbl2.StudentCollectionID

    Select
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID,
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchShortName,
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchName,
        COUNT(*) as "TotalCount",
        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as "VH",
        SUM(case when tbl.IsReturnMoney = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as "ReturnMoneyCount",
        SUM(case when tbl.IsReturnMoney = 1 and HP is not null then 1 else 0 end) as "ReturnMoneyCount_T",
        SUM(CASE WHEN tbl.Gender = '0' THEN 1 ELSE null END) AS "FemaleCount",
        SUM(CASE WHEN tbl.Gender = '1' THEN 1 ELSE null END) AS "MaleCount",
        SUM(case when TrainingLevelID IN ('NH', 'SC', 'TC') then 1 else 0 end) as "Total3_CER",
        SUM(case when HP is not null and TrainingLevelID IN ('NH', 'SC', 'TC') then 1 else 0 end) as "Total3_HP",
        SUM(case when HP is null and TrainingLevelID IN ('NH', 'SC', 'TC') and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else null end) as "N_HP",
        Sum(Case when SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223') and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else null end) as "KHTN",
        Sum(Case when SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID not in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223') and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else null end) as "KHXH",
        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1 and SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223') and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else null end) as "VH_KHTN",
        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1 and SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID not in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223') and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else null end) as "VH_KHXH",
        SUM(case when TrainingLevelID IN ('NH', 'SC', 'TC') and tbl.Description like 'TB%' then 1 else 0 end) as "CS_TB",
        SUM(case when TrainingLevelID IN ('NH', 'SC', 'TC') and tbl.Description like 'Q12%' and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as "CS_Q12",
        SUM(case when HP is not null and TrainingLevelID IN ('NH', 'SC', 'TC') and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as "CS1",
        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1
                    and SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223')
                    and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0
                    and tbl.StudentCollectionGroupID = 1
            then 1 else null end) as "VH_KHTN_KhoiThi_XH",
        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1
                    and SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223')
                    and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0
                    and tbl.StudentCollectionGroupID = 2
            then 1 else null end) as "VH_KHTN_KhoiThi_TN",
        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1
                    and SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID not in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223')
                    and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0
                    and tbl.StudentCollectionGroupID = 1
            then 1 else null end) as "VH_KHXH_KhoiThi_XH",
        SUM(case when tbl.IsStudyLogic = 1
                    and SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID not in ('5520159', '5510211', '5510314', '5520223')
                    and HP is not null and tbl.IsReturnMoney = 0
                    and tbl.StudentCollectionGroupID = 2
            then 1 else null end) as "VH_KHXH_KhoiThi_TN",
        SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.Quota
    Into #tblData
    from SIM_StudentCollection tbl
        Inner join #tblPeriod tblPeriod on tblPeriod.StudentCollectionPeriodID = tbl.StudentCollectionPeriodID
        Inner join SIM_SpecialBranch on SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID = tbl.SpecialBranchID
        LEFT JOIN SIM_StudentCollectionQuota ON SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.SpecialBranchID = tbl.SpecialBranchID
            and SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.YearID = @YearID
        Left join #tblHP on #tblHP.StudentCollectionID = tbl.StudentCollectionID
        Left join dbo.fnSplit(@SpecialBranchIDList, ';') as tblPart on tblPart.part = tbl.SpecialBranchID
        Left join dbo.fnSplit(@CourseID, ';') as tblCoursePart on tblCoursePart.part = tblPeriod.CourseID
    WHERE tbl.IsDeleted = 0
        and (@CourseID is null or tblCoursePart.part is not null or (Charindex(';', IsNull(@CourseID, '')) = 0 and tblPeriod.CourseID = @CourseID))
        and (@TrainingLevelID is null or tblPeriod.TrainingLevelID = @TrainingLevelID)
        and (@TrainingType is null or tblPeriod.TrainingType = @TrainingType)
        AND (@BranchID IS NULL OR SIM_SpecialBranch.BranchID = @BranchID)
        And (@SpecialBranchID is null or SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID = @SpecialBranchID)
        and (@SpecialBranchIDList is null or tblPart.part is not null)
        AND (@FromDate IS NULL OR tbl.ReceiveDate >= @FromDate)
        AND (@ToDate IS NULL OR tbl.ReceiveDate <= @ToDate)
    Group by SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchID,
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchShortName,
        SIM_SpecialBranch.SpecialBranchName,
        SIM_StudentCollectionQuota.Quota

    Select *,
        (Select SUM(FemaleCount) from #tblData) as FemaleCount_2,
        (Select SUM(MaleCount) from #tblData) as "MaleCount_2",
        CAST((TotalCount * 100.0) / NULLIF(Quota, 0) AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) as "Percent",
        Total3_CER - ReturnMoneyCount as "T1",
        Total3_HP - ReturnMoneyCount_T as T2,
        CS1 as T4,
        CS_TB as T5,
        CS_Q12 as T6,
        VH_KHTN_KhoiThi_XH as T7,
        VH_KHTN_KhoiThi_TN as T8,
        VH_KHXH_KhoiThi_XH as T9,
        VH_KHXH_KhoiThi_TN as T10,
        'a' as T11
    from #tblData
    Order by SpecialBranchID

    Drop table #tblPeriod
    Drop table #tblData
    Drop table #tblHP
END
GO

content.text:
**Store gốc ổn về logic**, nhưng cần chỉnh vài điểm trước khi dùng web. Đã tạo page **Tổng quan tuyển sinh** theo pattern dashboard hiện có.

### Rà store `SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB`
| Vấn đề | Xử lý |
|--------|--------|
| `@ToDate` lúc 00:00:00 bỏ sót hồ sơ trong ngày | Cộng đến 23:59:59 |
| Khóa / chuyên ngành chỉ lọc 1 giá trị | Hỗ trợ list `,` hoặc `;` |
| `ORDER BY` trong `SELECT INTO` | Bỏ; sort ở SELECT cuối |
| Thiếu mã nghề ngắn | Thêm `SpecialBranchShortName` |

Bản sửa: `sql/SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB.sql`  
(file trong `sql/tuyển sinh/` đang UTF-16 nên không ghi đè được)

### Page mới
- Menu: **Thống kê tuyển sinh → Tổng quan tuyển sinh**
- URL: `/dashboard-thong-ke-tuyen-sinh.html`
- Lọc: **Năm học** (chỉ tiêu), **Khóa**, **Chuyên ngành**, **Từ ngày – Đến ngày**
- KPI: Đã tuyển / Chỉ tiêu / % / Rút tiền–Đã đóng HP
- Biểu đồ theo khóa + theo tháng
- Bảng theo chuyên ngành (giống màn WinForms)

### SQL cần chạy trên DB
1. `sql/DASH_StudentAdmission_GetFilter.sql`
2. `sql/DASH_StudentAdmission_GetData.sql`
3. (tuỳ chọn) `sql/SIM_StudentCollection_TK_ChiTieu_WEB.sql` nếu vẫn dùng store WinForms
